gold_intro_1: Igolide lisetshenziselwe njengomali izinkulungwane zeminyaka futhi libhekwa ngabaningi njengendawo ephephile yezezimali.
gold_intro_2: I-Bitcoin iyimali yedijithali eyasungulwa ngo-2009 futhi ibhekwa ngabaningi njengendawo ephephile yezezimali.
gold_intro_3: Kodwa insimbi yengokoqobo efana negolide ihluke kanjani emalini yedijithali efana ne-Bitcoin? Ake sibheke umehluko phakathi kwezinhlobo ezimbili zemali: I-Bitcoin & Igolide.
point_1_summary_1: I-Bitcoin ingathunyelelwa ngokushesha nge-inthanethi ngezimali eziphansi. Igolide kumele lithunyelwe ngokwenyama ukuze kudluliselwe ubunini.
point_2_summary_1: I-Bitcoin iyimpahla yedijithali ngokwemvelo ongayihambisa nge-inthanethi. Igolide elise-inthanethi liyi-Digital IOU — unobunini besithembiso esivela kumgcini, hhayi insimbi uqobo.
point_3_summary_1: I-Bitcoin inomkhawulo oqinile we-21 million BTC. Ukukhiqizwa kwegolide kukhula cishe nge-1.6% unyaka ngamunye, kunciphisa icesho lakho — kungaphansi kwe
point_4_summary_1: Lapho intengo yegolide ikhuphuka, kumbiwa elidlulele, kupushe intengo phansi. Ukukhiqizwa kwe-Bitcoin akunwebeki — noma intengo iya kuyiphi indawo, kuyoba khona kuphela u-21 million.
point_4_summary_2: Nge-Bitcoin, noma intengo inyuka kangakanani, awukwazi ukwenza ngaphezu kwe-21M Bitcoin.
point_4_summary_3: I-Bitcoin iyinto yokuqala enobudlelwano obungalinwebeki phakathi kwentengo nenani.
point_5_summary_1: Amashumi ezinkulungwane zama-node azimele aqinisekisa inethiwekhi ye-Bitcoin. Iningi legolide elingokoqobo lihlala ezimbadwini ezimbalwa zezigcina ezinkulu.
point_5_summary_2: Amashumi ezinkulungwane ama-node azimele aqinisekisa imithetho yenethiwekhi.
point_6_summary_1: Noma ubani angaqinisekisa i-Bitcoin yangempela ngokusebenzisa i-full node — kuyiphi nje uhlelo lokusebenza. Ukuqinisekisa igolide elingokoqobo kudinga ukuliqothula; ngaphakathi kungaba i-tungsten.
point_6_summary_3: I-full node iyisoftware elula eqinisekisa ukuthi imithetho yenethiwekhi iyalandelwa, futhi iqinisekisa ukuthi unayo i-Bitcoin yangempela.
point_7_summary_1: I-Bitcoin yahlukaniswa ngama-sats angu-100 million, okuyenza ibe yinhle kunoma yiluphi usayizi lokuthenga. Igolide alikwazi ukuhlukaniswa kalula ezinkokhelweni ezincane.
point_7_summary_2: Lokhu kwenza i-Bitcoin ibe enhle ebhizinisini.
